# Introduction

This document implements a complete preprocessing pipeline for single-cell RNA-seq data
starting from AnnData (.h5ad) files. The workflow converts the data into a Seurat object,
performs basic quality control filtering based on mitochondrial gene expression,
and prepares the dataset for downstream analyses such as normalization, clustering,
and visualization.


# Libraries

```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(reticulate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(DescTools)
library(scales)
source("/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/functions.R")
```

# Dataset definition

All datasets to be processed are defined in a single list.
Each entry contains paths for .h5ad, metadata, and output Seurat object.

To add a new dataset, simply append a new GSE entry to this list.

```{r}
datasets <- list(
  
  GSE144735 = list(
    h5ad = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATAH/GSE144735.h5ad",
    meta = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATA/GSE144735_annotation.txt",
    save = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATA/obj_GSE144735_QC.rds"
  ),
  
  GSE132465 = list(
    h5ad = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATAH/GSE132465.h5ad",
    meta = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATA/GSE132465_annotation.txt",
    save = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATA/obj_GSE132465_QC.rds"
  ),
  
  GSE132257 = list(
    h5ad = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATAH/GSE132257.h5ad",
    meta = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATA/GSE132257_processed_protocol_and_fresh_frozen_cell_annotation.txt",
    save = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATA/obj_GSE132257_QC.rds"
  )
  
)

# To add a fourth dataset:
# simply add another element in the list above following the same structure.
```

# Preprocessing pipeline (loop over datasets)

This loop automatically processes all datasets defined above and stores the resulting
Seurat objects in a list.

```{r}
obj_list <- list()

for (name in names(datasets)) {
  
  cat("Processing dataset:", name, "\n")
  
  obj_list[[name]] <- load_h5ad_to_seurat(
    h5ad_file = datasets[[name]]$h5ad,
    meta_file = datasets[[name]]$meta,
    save_path = datasets[[name]]$save
  )
  
  cat("Completed dataset:", name, "\n\n")
}

print(names(obj_list))

out_dir <- "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/DATA"

saveRDS(obj_list, file.path(out_dir, "obj_list_all.rds"))

obj_list[[1]]

```

# Merge Datasets

```{r}
dir.create("OUT", showWarnings = FALSE)
merged_obj <- merge_seurat_objects(
  obj_list = obj_list,
  save_path = "/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/OUT/merged_seurat_QC.rds"
)

# Check Merged objs

dim(merged_obj)

print(merged_obj)

table(merged_obj$GSE)

head(merged_obj@meta.data)

# Remove obj_list

rm(obj_list)
gc()
```
# QC Visualization (Supplementary 1A)

This section evaluates basic quality control metrics across datasets,
including number of detected genes, total counts, and mitochondrial percentage.

```{r}
merged_obj <- readRDS("/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/OUT/merged_seurat_QC.rds")
obj <- merged_obj

# define dataset colors (consistent palette)
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(obj$GSE)))

VlnPlot(
  obj,
  features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
  group.by = "GSE",
  cols = cols,
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0
)
```


# Dimensionality Reduction

This section performs normalization, feature selection, scaling,
PCA, and UMAP embedding for downstream visualization.

```{r}
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)

obj <- FindVariableFeatures(
  obj,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2000
)

obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj))

obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), npcs = 30)

ElbowPlot(obj)

obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:15)
```


# Save Processed Object

Save the processed Seurat object after normalization and dimensionality reduction.

```{r}
dir.create("OUT", showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(
  obj,
  file.path("OUT", "merged_normalized_hvgs.rds")
)
```


# UMAP Visualization (Supplementary 1B)

This section visualizes batch effects across datasets using UMAP.

```{r}
DimPlot(
  obj,
  group.by = "GSE",
  cols = cols
) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# Cell Type Annotation (Reference Labels)
This section performs cell type visualization, data preparation for
scMRMA, automated annotation, and validation against original labels.

## Original Cell Type Visualization

Visualize annotated cell types provided in the dataset.

```{r}
plot_cell_types(obj, "Cell_type")
```


## Prepare Data for scMRMA
  
Extract normalized expression matrix required for annotation.

```{r}
tmp <- prepare_scrmra_input(obj)

obj <- tmp$obj
logcounts <- tmp$logcounts
```

  
## Run scMRMA Annotation
  
Perform automated cell type prediction using reference-based annotation.

```{r}
obj <- run_scrmra_annotation(obj, logcounts)
```

  
## Annotation Validation
  
Compare original annotations with scMRMA predictions.

```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(table(obj$Cell_type, obj$cell_type1))
colnames(df) <- c("Original", "Validation", "Fraction")

ggplot(df, aes(x = Original, y = Fraction, fill = Validation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip()
```

  
# Re-check Visualization (Optional)
  
Visual confirmation of original labels.

```{r}
plot_cell_types(obj, "Cell_type")
```

# Cell type specificity
This section quantifies cell type specificity of lncRNAs and protein-coding genes
using the Gini coefficient computed from DotPlot-based expression summaries.

```{r}
obj <- readRDS("/mnt/akira/home/vmoriello/OUT/merged_seurat_QC.rds")

obj <- seurat_preprocess(obj)

gencode <- read.table("DATA/gencode_v49.txt", header = TRUE)

gene_sets <- gene_biotype_matching(obj, gencode)

lnc_features <- gene_sets$lnc
prot_features <- gene_sets$prot
ambiguous_genes <- gene_sets$ambiguous

chunk_size <- 1000

GiniCoef_lnc <- compute_gini_pipeline(obj, lnc_features, "lncRNA", chunk_size)
GiniCoef_prot <- compute_gini_pipeline(obj, prot_features, "protein_coding", chunk_size)

GiniCoef <- rbind(GiniCoef_lnc, GiniCoef_prot)
colnames(GiniCoef)[1] <- "gene"

saveRDS(GiniCoef, "OUT/gini_dotplot_v49.Rds")

GiniCoef <- readRDS("OUT/gini_dotplot.Rds")

GiniCoef_clean <- GiniCoef[!is.na(GiniCoef$gini), ]

lnc_n  <- nrow(GiniCoef_clean %>% filter(type == "lncRNA"))
prot_n <- nrow(GiniCoef_clean %>% filter(type == "protein_coding"))

plot_gini_results(GiniCoef_clean, lnc_n, prot_n)
```

# Epithetial lncRNAs
```{r}
# Load GENCODE annotation
gencode <- read.table(
  "DATA/gencode_v49.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Prepare lncRNA gene list
lnc_genes <- prepare_epithelial_lnc_analysis(obj, gencode)

# DotPlot expression for lncRNAs
lnc_percent <- DotPlot(obj, features = lnc_genes)$data

# Differential expression in epithelial cells
M <- run_epithelial_markers(obj, lnc_genes)

# Filter DotPlot using significant markers
lnc_percent2 <- filter_dotplot_by_markers(
  lnc_percent,
  M,
  cell_order = c(
    "B cells",
    "Epithelial cells",
    "Mast cells",
    "Myeloids",
    "Stromal cells",
    "T cells"
  )
)
```

# Epithelial lncRNA visualization + TCGA integration


# 1C - Example epithelial lncRNA density plot
obj_umap <- readRDS("OUT/merged_normalized_hvgs.Rds")

example_gene <- select_example_gene(
  obj = obj,
  gene = "LINC00523",
  fallback_genes = rownames(M)
)

plot_density(obj_umap, features = example_gene)

# 1D - Expression across cell types
plot_lnc_boxplot(
  lnc_percent2,
  palette = kelly()[c(3,7,4,5,6,8)]
)

# Integration with TCGA data
We accessed the COAD TCGA data via the GEPIA2 webserver and performed differential expression analysis between tumor and normal samples.

# 2A - TCGA overlap analysis
tcga <- prepare_tcga_overlap(
  tcga_file = "DATA/coad.tcga.txt",
  gencode = gencode,
  marker_genes = rownames(M)
)

ggvenn(
  tcga$x,
  fill_color = c(viridis::viridis(11)[c(11,1)], kelly()[7]),
  show_percentage = FALSE,
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 4,
  fill_alpha = 0.85
) +
  ggtitle("TCGA - Epithelial lncRNAs overlap") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))


# 2B - TCGA DEGs barplot
plot_tcga_barplot(tcga$COAD)

# 2C - TCGA scatter tumor vs normal
plot_tcga_scatter(
  tcga$COAD,
  color = kelly()[7]
)
```
